objects.label: Indian 2-rupee coin, 2019 series (silver-coloured)
objects.source: Coinage of One Rupee, Two Rupees, Five Rupees, Ten Rupees and Twenty Rupees Rules, 2019 (Ministry of Finance notification G.S.R. 184(E), 6 March 2019): circular, ferritic stainless steel, outside diameter 23 mm.
objects.notes: Pilot only. Older silver 2-rupee coins (27 mm) are still in circulation, so the remote pilot makes the volunteer measure the coin with a ruler first. diameter_uncertainty_mm is an assumed allowance; the notification gives no diameter tolerance. Thickness is not specified there, so calibration.custom_reference_thickness_mm is assumed.

objects.label: Indian 1-rupee coin, 2019 series (silver-coloured)
objects.source: Coinage of One Rupee, Two Rupees, Five Rupees, Ten Rupees and Twenty Rupees Rules, 2019 (Ministry of Finance notification G.S.R. 184(E), 6 March 2019): circular, ferritic stainless steel, outside diameter 20 mm.
objects.notes: Pilot only. Older silver 1-rupee coins (25 mm) are still in circulation, so the remote pilot makes the volunteer measure the coin with a ruler first. At 20 mm it is more often too small in the image than the 2-rupee coin. diameter_uncertainty_mm is an assumed allowance; thickness is assumed as for the 2-rupee coin.
